entries.label: fmt, check-sql.py, cargo deny, locked host+wasm32 clippy, boundaries, duet-notify
command:
set -euo pipefail
    cargo fmt --all --check
    python3 scripts/check-sql.py
    cargo deny check
    cargo clippy --locked -p duet-notify -p duet-api -p boundaries --all-targets -- -D warnings
    cargo clippy --locked -p duet-app --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib --bins -- -D warnings
    cargo test --locked -p boundaries
    cargo test --locked -p duet-notify

entries.label: duet-api lib and all 11 real-Postgres integration suites
command:
set -euo pipefail
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --lib
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --test push_harness_and_memory_retention
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --test portals_and_health_connect
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --test database_foundation
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --test durable_owners
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --test evidence_cohort
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --test fresh_producers
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --test health_context_producer
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --test hosting
    cargo test --locked -p duet-api --test phone_outbox

entries.label: iOS/Android native notification bridge runtime
entries.reason: iOS Xcode Simulator (NotificationBridge.swift) and Android KVM emulator (NotificationBridge.kt) runtime execution are unavailable on this Linux host; Rust bridge decoders, token redaction, generic zero-PHI lock-screen payloads, and sign-out cleanup transitions are verified by duet-notify unit tests and duet-api Postgres tests.
